strategic_priorities.text: Slowing the pace of investments in 2023 given the external environment, while continuing to execute the strategy
strategic_priorities.quote:
Thus, while we are 

executing our strategy, we are slowing the pace of investments in 2023. A more cautious 

pace makes sense, given the challenges in the external environment.

strategic_priorities.text: Debt repayment as a near- to intermediate-term priority for cash deployment, maintaining a conservative balance sheet
strategic_priorities.quote:
We have historically taken a conservative 

approach to managing our balance sheet, and that isn’t changing. Over time, we seek to 

balance capital allocation priorities, but debt repayment will be a near- to intermediate-term 

priority for the deployment of cash.

strategic_priorities.text: Building a comprehensive, end-to-end wealth platform under the Morningstar Wealth umbrella for independent advisors
strategic_priorities.quote:
Our vision here is meaningful. We are building a comprehensive, end-to-end wealth 

platform designed to help independent advisors through every step of their 

investment workflow.

strategic_priorities.text: Strengthen the wealth platform and increase advisor adoption in 2023
strategic_priorities.quote:
Our focus this year is to continue 

to strengthen our platform and to get more advisors using it. If we succeed, our wealth 

strategy will be a meaningful driver of our business in the years to come.

strategic_priorities.text: Delivering differentiated insights across asset classes to public and private market investors
strategic_priorities.quote:
Delivering Differentiated Insights Across Asset Classes to 

Public and Private Market Investors

strategic_priorities.text: Establishing leading ESG positions across each business and making ESG accessible to retail investors
strategic_priorities.quote:
ESG has been the domain of institutional 

investors to date, and we’re committed to making it accessible, understandable, and 

personal for Main Street.

strategic_priorities.text: Driving operational excellence and scalability, including migrating on-premises data centers to the cloud
strategic_priorities.quote:
A key focus in recent years has been the migration of our on-premises data centers to 

the cloud and a focus on building new products and capabilities in the cloud.

strategic_priorities.text: Building an inclusive culture that supports exceptional talent, with a goal of filling 40% of non-entry-level positions internally in 2023
strategic_priorities.quote:
In 2022, we filled 37% of our non-entry-level positions with internal hires; 

our goal for 2023 is 40%.

strategic_priorities.text: Regaining full control of the Morningstar brand in Japan by exiting the SoftBank-era licensing agreement
strategic_priorities.quote:
we’ve announced that we’re regaining full control of our 

brand in Japan as we exit a licensing agreement that dates to the establishment 

of a joint venture with SoftBank in 1998.

say that we underestimated the opportunity in the private debt arena when we

notable_language.why_notable: Distinguishes Morningstar's buyback philosophy from peers; recurring capital-allocation rhetoric.
